title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Pineapple Lemon Burst Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Pineapple Lemon Burst Nic Salt is a bright, citrusy vape that pairs tropical Pineapple with zesty Lemon. The Pineapple adds fruity sharpness and sweetness, while Lemon brings a fizzy, citrus tang that cuts through the richness. A lively flavour with tropical edge. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod systems and vape pens. Available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth and satisfying nicotine hit. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
